newsitem.title: USA: Crown Books same-store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Crown Books same-store sales fall.

text.p: Crown Books Corp said on Tuesday that sales increased 6.5 percent to $66.6 million for the 13 weeks ended May 3, 1997 compared to $62.5 million for the 13 week period ended May 4, 1996, but same-store sales fell 3.0 percent for the period.

Comparable store sales for all superstores for the same 13 week period decreased, the company said. Comparable store sales for the new prototype superstores for the same 13 week period decreased three percent, Crown said.
